hazard: Turnstile remains locked during a surge
cause: Gate controller loses power or stalls with the gate latched
effect: Crush or crowd pressure at the gate
mitigation: Fail-secure state is the configured safe state and egress release is mechanical and outside TirBase

hazard: Gate cannot decide while disconnected
cause: Venue network or server unavailable
effect: Gates stop or admit without policy
mitigation: Signed policy is cached locally and the gate kernel decides offline; reconnect reconciles

hazard: Power loss at the gate
cause: Supply failure or breaker trip
mitigation: Gate reaches the configured safe state on power loss and recovers to a defined state

hazard: Revoked ticket or credential admitted offline
cause: Offline cache is stale or never synced
mitigation: Feed sync before gates open; revocation enforced from its own timestamp; stale cache blocks authoritative offline operation

hazard: Replayed scan admits twice
cause: Rety or malicious replay of a scan
effect: Occupancy above plan or unauthorised re-entry
mitigation: Deterministic scan idempotency key and replay answer from the original decision

hazard: Occupancy exceeds the approved envelope
cause: No live count or envelope not configured
mitigation: Capacity envelopes are configured and refusal is explicit; live count is verified at commissioning

hazard: Lockdown command is not applied or is applied without authority
cause: Wrong role or approval path; network loss
mitigation: Approved lockdown controls with role and quorum checks plus drill evidence

hazard: Emergency egress blocked by a turnstile
cause: Software or controller holds a gate closed during evacuation
mitigation: Egress release is mechanical and independent of TirBase; life-safety systems are not controlled by the connector

hazard: Connector reaches a fire or life-safety system
cause: Misconfigured BMS mapping or a vendor point write
mitigation: Life-safety markers are refused as point kinds ids families and writes; unknown families are refused

hazard: Two venues or tenants read each other's data
cause: Shared deployment or misconfigured tenancy
mitigation: Tenant scoping in the runtime and connector venue binding

hazard: Gate decision uses a jumped clock
cause: Clock drift or manual time change
mitigation: Monotonic decision clock and clock-jump immunity tested in the HIL campaign

hazard: CCTV metadata retained beyond policy
cause: No purge or legal hold mishandled
mitigation: Metadata-only store with enforced 7/30/90-day retention holds and audited access

hazard: Credential holder data exposed
cause: Feed carries more than an opaque reference
mitigation: Minimised credential schema pseudonymous references and retention rules

hazard: Announcement duplicated or sent to the wrong zone
cause: Replay or a misconfigured zone list
mitigation: Template rendering with mandatory parameters explicit zones and an audit log; replay is a duplicate

hazard: Incident not detected or escalated
cause: No monitoring or unclear on-call
mitigation: Monitoring thresholds on-call rota and incident-command roles

hazard: Gateway or connector compromised
cause: Unpatched firmware weak credentials or exposed admin
effect: Unauthorised gate control or data loss
mitigation: Supported firmware baseline credential rotation network segmentation and audited admin

hazard: Controller or reader failure during an event
cause: Component fault or unsupported firmware
mitigation: Spares holding and a supported-firmware window with an EOL policy

hazard: Untrained staff operate the system
cause: No certification or handover
mitigation: Integrator certification training exam badge and commissioning checklist

hazard: Seat or zone mapping wrong at commissioning
cause: Manual mapping error
mitigation: Mapping validation with conflict refusal and a signed commissioning check

hazard: Ticketing or access vendor outage during ingress
cause: Vendor service failure
mitigation: Offline cache and documented fallback with reconciliation after the event
